newsitem.title: CHINA: China boosts investment in service sector.
newsitem.headline: China boosts investment in service sector.

text.p: China's investment in fixed assets in the service sector rose by 19.2 percent in January-November last year from 1995 to reach 599.47 billion yuan, the State Statistical Bureau said.
In the sector, transportation, posts and telecommunications absorbed 195.21 billion yuan, up 19.9 percent from the year-ago period, it said.
The banking and insurance sectors absorbed 8.47 billion yuan in investment, up 15.2 percent from the year-ago period.
Investment in commerce, food service, materials supply and marketing, and warehousing amounted to 26.78 billion yuan, down 9.0 percent compared with a year ago, it said.
Investment in real estate management, public residential and consultancy services was 263.52 billion yuan, up 27.1 percent.
Culture and arts, education, health, broadcasting and social welfare attracted 31.26 billion yuan, a rise of 23 percent.
